title: A non-trivially non-trivial automorphism at an inaccessible cardinal
summary: We show that, relative to the existence of an inaccessible cardinal, it is consistent that for an inaccessible cardinal $κ$, there is a non-trivial automorphism of $\mathcal{P}(κ)/\mathrm{fin}$ whose restriction to $\mathcal{P}(β)/\mathrm{fin}$ is induced by a bijection on $β$ for every $β<κ$. This answers questions posed by Larson--McKenney, Shelah--Steprāns, and Veličković.
